description: Land Aquisition - Thelangapatha, Waththala D/S Division, Gampaha District Sec.07
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of 37 land allotments for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, current uses, and claimants. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions, property ownership matters, and land registrations.
